newsitem.title: ITALY: SOCCER - BARI'S ANNONI BEATEN UP BY FANS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER - BARI'S ANNONI BEATEN UP BY FANS.

text.p: Bari defender Paolo Annoni was recovering on Saturday after being attacked by a gang of hostile fans late on Friday, Italian news agencies said.
Annoni's face was cut and bruised in the attack in the centre of the southern city but he was recovering at home after a brief hospital visit, the agencies said.
"I feel anguished. It was horrible, especially when I saw myself in the mirror with blood all over my shirt," Annoni told Italian television on Saturday.
"I felt at home in this club -- I still do. But I can't say for sure what the future will bring now."
It was unclear whether Annoni would play in Sunday's second division home match against Empoli.

Corriere dello Sport daily quoted the player as saying: "There were five or six of them and they greeted me like they were fans. Then they started beating me, yelling epithets against the club, saying we had to show what we were made of."
Club coach Eugenio Fascetti said: "It's an embarrassment to Bari and shameful. Now we must find the guilty ones."
Bari, relegated to the second division last season, are in ninth place, eight points behind leaders Lecce.
